description.text: International Economics and Trade is an undergraduate major in ordinary institutions of higher learning in China, belonging to the category of economics and trade. The code for this major is 020401, and the duration of study is four years. Upon completion, students will be awarded a Bachelor of Economics degree. Here is a detailed introduction: Professional Overview: This major mainly focuses on the study of basic knowledge and skills in economics principles, international economy, international trade, etc. It aims to enable students to understand the current environment and development status of China's foreign trade and contemporary international economic and trade. Students will also become familiar with international trade rules, laws and conventions, as well as China's foreign trade policies and regulations. Subsequently, they will be able to engage in import and export business and foreign economic and trade activities.Training Objectives: To cultivate application-oriented, multi-disciplinary, and internationalized talents with good moral character and ethical standards. They should have a systematic grasp of the basic knowledge and theories of economics and trade studies, be familiar with international trade rules, be proficient in using a foreign language and modern information technology, possess excellent communication, coordination, and innovation capabilities, and have an entrepreneurial spirit.

duration.text: The International Economics and Trade at Xi'an University of Finance And Economics is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 1944 USD/per year ￥ 14000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. "Information Form for International Students from Xi'an University of Finance and Economics" Download URL: http://guojiao.xaufe.edu.cn/info/1084/2264.htm2. Valid personal passport; 3. Study Plan, no less than 300 words; 4. Highest educational qualification certificate (Fresh graduates should provide a certificate indicating expected graduation); 5. Academic transcript 6. Certificate of No Criminal Record of the Country, valid for 6 months; 7. Recommendation letter from the school where you are currently studying; 8. "Foreigner Physical Examination Form" 9. Proof of Chinese Language Learning (if any); 10. Other materials that can demonstrate one's comprehensive qualities (if any).

requirements.text: 1. Have the nationality of the countries along the "the Belt and Road", hold a valid foreign ordinary passport, be friendly to China, and be healthy.2. Have good conduct, abide by laws and regulations, be diligent and eager to learn, and have no record of illegal or criminal activities.3. Applicants must have a degree equivalent to that of a Chinese high school graduate and be under the age of 25 (students under the age of 18 must provide a power of attorney and other materials from their legal guardian).
